translations.web: “You have covered us with anger and pursued us. You have killed. You have not pitied.
translations.bsb: You have covered Yourself in anger and pursued us; You have killed without pity.
translations.kjv: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.
